title: hyperOpenSeadragon: a browser-based viewer for multi-channel fluorescence and hyperspectral microscopy
description: hyperOpenSeadragon is a browser-based viewer for multi-channel fluorescence and hyperspectral microscopy images. It blends up to 16 channels per z-plane on the GPU with per-channel colour and gain, supports z-stacks, linear spectral unmixing with a built-in matrix editor and spectrum inspector, in-browser PICASSO unmixing, virtual H&E and Masson trichrome rendering, display-only denoising and multi-class pixel annotation, and includes a tile generator that converts microscopy TIFFs into Deep Zoom pyramids.
